cause: Phonology.vowels omits î; State.absorb sets lastWasVowel false, so suffix buffers y/n are not emitted.
reference_scope: TDK describes nispet î and retaining circumflex in suffixed words; paired diagnostic forms authored for this test.
limits: Production morphology acceptance test, not a typing/space replacement test.
Isolated roots use noun category and test-only pronunciation milli/ferdi/resmi; production adjective roots also use nominal suffix continuation.
No production change; adding a pronunciation per root is diagnostic, not proposed comprehensive fix.
